 . This is an application for bail under Section 438 of the Code of
 Criminal Procedure.

The applicant claims to have an apprehension of  being arrested in connection with Crime No.0118/2019, registered at  Sonai Police Station, Tq. Newasa, Dist. Ahmednagar, for the offences  punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code  and under Section 59 read with Sections 3.1.7 of the Food Safety and  Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Sonai Police Station, Tq. Newasa, Dist. Ahmednagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard.
Perused the First Information Report (FIR) and related  papers.
FIR has been lodged by the Food Safety Officer on 28.03.2019.
It  is alleged in the FIR that a vehicle - Maruti Suzuki Omni MH-17  AJ-1182, was intercepted at Pandhricha Pul.
Govind Loya was in the  driver seat.
On search of the vehicle, it was found to have contained  contraband food articles, namely, 208 packets of Hira Pan Masala, 208  packets of Royal Tobacco and 51 packets of Goa Gutkha.
Those articles  came to be seized under the panchnama.
The applicant claims to have  apprehension of arrest, since, accused Govind Loya seems to have  informed the police that he had purchased those food articles from the  applicant and others.

3. I have observed that Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code is not  applicable in case of storing, sale or transporting contraband articles,
 namely, Gutkha, Pan Masala, Tobacco etc.
Rest of the offences are  bailable one.
Except the statement of co-accused, there is nothing to  indicate the applicant's involvement in the alleged offence.
Contraband  articles have been seized on the spot.
I am, therefore, inclined to grant  anticipatory bail to the applicant.

Hence, following order:
